Package es.upm.dit.cnvr_fcon.bank_2025.common

Class NodeJG

java.lang.Object
es.upm.dit.cnvr_fcon.bank_2025.common.NodeJG
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jgroups.Receiver
public class NodeJG extends Object implements org.jgroups.Receiver
This class manages the counter and connects in the cluster group. It receives and processes multicast messages. For this purpose, it implements the org.jgroups.Receiver interface

    • NodeJG

      public NodeJG(String cluster)
      The constructor. It adds the process to the group, by connecting to a channel. It creates all the objects for managing the distributed counter. Initially, it gets the system counter state.
      Parameters:
      cluster - the name of the group cluster
